mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to higher inflation expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL is increasing, but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strong demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < -0.5% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.
